sectionTitle: ÔN TẬP PHẦN 3 · DỰNG CÂU - SENTENCE CONSTRUCTION
sectionDesc: Bộ đề HOMEWORK môn Anh Văn - Phần 3. Gồm 2 phần: Sentence Construction (dựng câu) và Communication (hội thoại). Phần này: viết lại câu hoàn chỉnh theo các từ gợi ý.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: every afternoon / Peter / play / basketball / friends.
questions.correctAnswer: Every afternoon, Peter plays basketball with his friends.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: my sister / study / at / university / Ho Chi Minh City.
questions.correctAnswer: My sister studies at a university in Ho Chi Minh City.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: the children / usually / have / lunch / at / school.
questions.correctAnswer: The children usually have lunch at school.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: last Saturday / we / visit / our / old teacher / countryside.
questions.correctAnswer: Last Saturday, we visited our old teacher in the countryside.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: Anna / enjoy / read / books / about / history.
questions.correctAnswer: Anna enjoys reading books about history.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: my parents / buy / fresh vegetables / at / local market / every weekend.
questions.correctAnswer: My parents buy fresh vegetables at the local market every weekend.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: David / finish / his homework / before / dinner / yesterday.
questions.correctAnswer: David finished his homework before dinner yesterday.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: the manager / speak / English / very well / at / work.
questions.correctAnswer: The manager speaks English very well at work.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: I / want / go / to / beach / but / my brother / prefer / stay / home.
questions.correctAnswer: I want to go to the beach, but my brother prefers to stay at home.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: Lisa / finish / her assignment / and / she / send / it / to / teacher / tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: Lisa will finish her assignment and send it to her teacher tomorrow.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: today / the weather / be / very hot / so / we / decide / stay / indoors.
questions.correctAnswer: Today, the weather is very hot, so we decide to stay indoors.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: you / can / order / pizza / or / you / can / cook / dinner / at / home.
questions.correctAnswer: You can order pizza, or you can cook dinner at home.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: Tom / feel / tired / but / he / continue / work / on / project / tonight.
questions.correctAnswer: Tom feels tired, but he will continue working on the project tonight.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: Mary / clean / the kitchen / and / her husband / wash / the dishes / every day.
questions.correctAnswer: Mary cleans the kitchen, and her husband washes the dishes every day.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: we / want / go / shopping / but / the stores / be / closed / last week.
questions.correctAnswer: We wanted to go shopping, but the stores were closed last week.

sectionTitle: ÔN TẬP PHẦN 3 · HỘI THOẠI - COMMUNICATION
sectionDesc: Bộ đề HOMEWORK môn Anh Văn - Phần 3. Gồm 2 phần: Sentence Construction (dựng câu) và Communication (hội thoại). Phần này: chọn câu trả lời phù hợp trong hội thoại.

questions.question:
Nam: Could you help me carry these books upstairs?
Mai: "___________"
answers: Sure. I'll help you.
That's a good idea.
I'd love to, but it's delicious.
You're welcome.

questions.question:
Tom: Would you mind opening the window?
Anna: "___________"
answers: Yes, I would like it.
Not at all.
Never mind.
That's a good idea.

questions.question:
Peter: I can't hear the teacher very well.
John: "___________"
answers: I'd love to hear it.
That's all right, thank you.
You should sit closer to the front.
You're welcome for the teacher.

questions.question:
Lan: Let's go to the cinema this evening.
Susan: "___________"
answers: We don't have any film.
Let's take the seat.
You went to the theater.
I've seen the film already.

questions.question:
David: Why don't we have dinner at that new restaurant?
Mike: "___________"
answers: I've already eaten there twice this week.
I had dinner at six yesterday.
You should cook at the restaurant.
The restaurant was eating dinner.

questions.question:
Jenny: How about going to the beach this weekend?
Linda: "___________"
answers: The beach was very crowded yesterday.
That sounds great, but I have to work on Saturday.
You can swim very well.
I went to the beach by bus yesterday.

questions.question:
Paul: Would you like to join us for lunch?
Mary: "___________"
answers: That's all right. You helped me.
I'd like lunch yesterday.
Yes, I'd love to.
Yes, I liked lunch yesterday.

questions.question:
Jack: Shall I carry that box for you?
Lucy: "___________"
answers: Yes, I carried it yesterday.
That's a good suggestion for dinner.
No, I didn't carry the box.
No, thanks. I can manage it myself.

questions.question:
Anna: I'm sorry I broke your favorite cup.
Lisa: "___________"
answers: That's all right. It was an accident.
That's a good idea. Let's buy dinner.
You're welcome. I bought it yesterday.
Yes, I'd love to break another one.

questions.question:
Mark: Thanks for helping me with my presentation.
Tom: "___________"
answers: Never mind. I was late.
You're welcome. I'm glad I could help.
That's a good idea for your presentation.
I'm sorry. I can't present it.

questions.question:
Sarah: I've been feeling really tired lately.
Emma: "___________"
answers: I agree that you were tired yesterday.
That's all right. I don't feel tired.
You should get more sleep and take some time to relax.
Would you like to feel tired?

questions.question:
Alex: I think students should use their phones less in class.
Ben: "___________"
answers: Would you like me to use your phone?
I'm sorry to use my phone yesterday.
That's all right. I don't have a phone.
I completely agree. They can be very distracting.

questions.question:
Jane: I think studying online is more convenient than studying in a classroom.
Mary: "___________"
answers: I'm not sure I agree. I think face-to-face classes are more interactive.
I'm sorry I studied online.
That's right. I studied online last night.
Would you like to study in the classroom yesterday?

questions.question:
David: I'm afraid I've lost your book.
Susan: "___________"
answers: You're welcome. I really enjoyed reading it.
Don't worry about it. I can buy another copy.
Yes, please. I lost my book yesterday.
That's a good idea. Let's lose another one.

questions.question:
Minh: I'm going to the library to study for tomorrow's test.
Nam: "___________"
answers: I'm sorry, the test was tomorrow.
You studied at the library yesterday.
Why don't we study together?
I don't think the library has any books.
